sentences.text: Blue Line Taxi Vaasa Oy is a company registered on 2026-08-26 under the industry code 49330, on-demand passenger transport by vehicle with driver.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-26, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-08-31.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a blue word but the registered industry is taxi service and the record shows no ocean use.
